notes: Prices in JPY from SNKRDUNK. This is run9, collected 2026-09-18 (Friday) via the built-in browser pane. Listings filtered to 販売中のみ (for-sale only); top-20 cheapest active listings taken per grade, with a 15% cutoff above the lowest listing (threshold = lowest * 1.15) splitting them into within_15pct vs excluded_over_15pct. The site's 安い順 (cheapest-first) sort was applied via the JS native-setter workaround and verified via screenshot (no SOLD-badge leakage) before extracting the top 20. recent_completed_sales are the most recent ~15-20 sales-history entries per grade, oldest-to-newest, filtered by the 状態 grade pill on the card's 売買履歴 section. PSA10 population/gem-rate sourced from altema.jp (pokekachi) for the 5 established cards, all re-verified unchanged from prior runs (10846/88.0%, 20026/88.7%, 80321/86.9%, 8102/81.5%, 49275/86.6%). image_url reused from the skill's cached table for all 11 cards. psa_tier_status omitted this run (JST is Friday, not Monday; the weekly PSA Value-tier check runs Mondays only). BIGGEST NEWS THIS RUN: two of the six M6a '30th CELEBRATION' cards (released 2026-09-16) now show their first-ever PSA10 activity on SNKRDUNK, three days after release - Card 7 (ミュウex SAR) has 1 active PSA10 listing at ¥12,980 plus 1 completed sale at ¥9,700, and Card 10 (ピカチュウex SAR, day version) has 1 active PSA10 listing at ¥12,980 with no completed sales yet. The other four M6a cards (Gengar ex, Jirachi ex, Mewtwo ex, and the night-version Pikachu ex) remain PSA10-empty. None of the six cards have gained altema.jp PSA10 population data yet - that metric lags behind first listings by design (population requires a batch of completed PSA gradings, not just one or two). All 6 M6a cards' A-grade markets remain very active on day 3 post-release, with sales-history turnover continuing in the minutes-old range across all of them; price levels are broadly similar to run8 with normal day-to-day noise, though several cards (6, 9, 10, 11) show their A-grade lowest listing up modestly from run8. The BGS9.5 listing on Card 8 (ジラーチex SAR) at ~¥4,900 remains active and unchanged; the Card 11 (ピカチュウex SAR, night) PSA9 slot noted absent since run7 remains absent. Notable findings among the 5 established cards vs run8 (collected 2026-09-17 ~23:23 JST): (1) Card 1 (ピカチュウVMAX CSR) PSA10 lowest listing held exactly steady at ¥28,000, with 3 new sales in the ¥26,999-27,000 range continuing the softening trend toward that listing level. (2) Card 2 (ピカチュウex SAR, SV8) PSA10 lowest listing dropped further to ¥72,000 from run8's ¥72,999, with a new completed sale at ¥70,999 - the softening trend has now pushed a completed sale below even the current lowest active listing, a further sign of continued price erosion. (3) Card 3 (ブラッキーex SAR) is a standout mover: PSA10 lowest listing dropped sharply to ¥71,000 from run8's steady ¥73,000 - the first move after holding firm across three prior runs - with several PSA10 sales in the last day (¥67,500-72,000) completing below even that new lower listing, confirming real transaction-level softening rather than just a listing artifact. (4) Card 4 (ゲンガーVMAX SA): the listings-vs-sales divergence run8 first flagged has persisted unchanged - PSA10 lowest active listing holds at ¥329,000 while completed sales remain clustered in the ¥280,000-299,999 range, a ~$29,000-49,000 gap between what sellers ask and what buyers actually pay. Notably, altema.jp's independently-sourced PSA10相場 for this card is ¥295,000 - much closer to SNKRDUNK's actual sales than its listing price, corroborating that the sales-side figure is the more representative market price. A-grade remains thin (still only 1 listing, ¥335,500, no new sale since 2026/06/29). (5) Card 5 (名探偵ピカチュウ プロモ) PSA10 edged up slightly to ¥42,300 from run8's ¥42,000 (normal noise) with heavy sales turnover in the last day tightly clustered ¥41,000-42,999, confirming that level continues to hold; A-grade steady at ¥27,000 lowest, matching run8 with no new completed sale. pokeca-chart.com index figures advanced to a new calendar day as expected (data_range now ...〜2026/09/17, vs run8's ...〜2026/09/16) - PSA10 index at 113,619 yen (day -1.7%, month -23.7%, year +16.5%), raw/美品 index at 52,380 yen (day +0.1%, month -4.1%, year +28.6%). Transaction-volume overlay (hover-based readings across the trailing month): PSA10 index transaction counts read roughly 374 (2026/07/20), 387 (2026/08/17), and 455 (2026/09/14) - a clear rising trend, a change from run8's 'flat' classification. Raw/美品 index transaction counts read roughly 60 (mid-period) and 39 (most recent, near 2026/09/17) - continuing to fall, consistent with run8's tapering-volume observation alongside the index's ongoing month-over-month price decline.
